# Character references (test fixtures)

Front-view characters for the character maker (`web/runtime/charmaker.js`).

- `male-adventurer.png`, `female-person.png`, `robot.png`, `zombie.png`: Kenney, Toon Characters (idle pose, HD), CC0, kenney.nl/assets/toon-characters
- `soldier.png`: Kenney, Platformer Characters (soldier idle), CC0, kenney.nl/assets/platformer-characters
- `realistic-person.png`: FLUX.1 Kontext's photo-real edit of `male-adventurer.png` (stage 2's realistic route, 2026-10-11), cut out with rembg, 256 px. A real person's proportions for `findParts`.
